description: This file implements the WebAudioPlayer IPC interface for the Rialto client, including factory methods, creation, control, and event handling for WebAudioPlayer instances via IPC mechanisms.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating WebAudioPlayerIpc instances.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc
classes.description: Main class implementing IPC communication for WebAudioPlayer, including control methods and event handling.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to a new WebAudioPlayerIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Creates a new WebAudioPlayerIpc instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Constructor initializing IPC connection and creating WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: ~WebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and detaching IPC channel.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stubs for IPC communication.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Sends a play command via IPC.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Sends a pause command via IPC.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sends an end-of-stream command via IPC.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes buffer data to the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new WebAudioPlayer instance with specified parameters.
